name: Back End Developer (Intern)
description:
## Qualifications

Pursuing/completed bachelor’s degree in related field

## About The Internship

We are looking for dedicated & creative Back End Developer (Intern) to push his/her coding skills to the limits and will work with our team of talented engineers and analysts to design and build a world class analytics product catering to Digital and Retail space. This role will suit someone who has extremely good technical skills but who is also ambitious to play a more strategic role in a growing company and build a strong team.

## Key Responsibilities

-   As a developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing and enhancing B2B Analytics products, according to the organization’s Product Development plan.
-   Will be responsible for understanding the requirements from the business teams and taking ownership of software development, including backend database development and front-end applications.
-   Analyzing user specifications and requirements that reflect business program needs, and subsequently delivering high-quality software solutions that meet those needs.
-   Full lifecycle development of web applications on the LAMP stack.

## Required Skills

-   Basic knowledge of PHP, Python, SQL and Object Oriented programming.
-   Good Experience with any of the following PHP frameworks: Zend, CakePHP, Symfony or Laravel OR Python frameworks like Django or Flask is a plus.
-   Practical knowledge of Enterprise Design Patterns.
-   Experience in SQL programming using an RDBMS like MySQL / MS SQL / PostgreSQL.
-   Basic understanding of front-end technologies, such as JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 would be beneficial.

### If you are creative, innovative, and inquisitive, and if you love working with dynamic people, we want you in our team!
